name: Reject_6
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand slightly outward and sweeps it inward across its front to indicate rejection or dismissiveness.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral rest pose, the robot raises its right arm forward and slightly to the side with an open, palm-up hand. It then sweeps the hand inward toward its chest while tilting the palm downward in a gentle brushing motion. Finally, the robot lowers its arm back down, returning smoothly to its neutral posture.
